product_updates.title: Flock reportedly tries to shrink workforce with employee buyouts
product_updates.content: Without buyouts, Flock would "almost certainly" need to lay off staff.

product_updates.title: Trump says it’s time to rebrand AI with a new name — and he’s also creating an AI Force
product_updates.content: Trump claimed, without evidence, that the AI backlash is a Democratic hoax.

product_updates.title: Google’s Gemini is the latest AI model to hack other companies
product_updates.content: Google said Gemini had "acted appropriately" by ending each hack immediately.

product_updates.title: Petlibro’s new AI-powered feeder is a game changer for multi-cat homes
product_updates.content: Petlibro's new Granary 2 smart feeders use a built-in scale and (on pricier models) an AI camera to track exactly how much your cat is eating and when — though the fanciest health-monitoring features will cost you an extra subscription.

product_updates.title: AI safety conversations have gotten unbelievable
product_updates.content: This week two conversations about AI safety went viral that demonstrate just how hard it is to discern AI fact from fiction.

product_updates.title: Prices go up in 7 days. Get your Disrupt ticket now.
product_updates.content: Current ticket pricing ends Sept. 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Join 10,000+ founders, investors and tech leaders at Disrupt and save up to $200 on your ticket until then..

product_updates.title: Vals, backed by Andreessen Horowitz, is looking to become the gold standard for AI benchmarking
product_updates.content: Vals AI is hoping to make AI benchmarking a more neutral and trustworthy resource in a world increasingly inundated by AI models.

product_updates.title: India forces caller-ID apps to feed spam reports to telcos
product_updates.content: Truecaller says the one-way sharing requirement would hand a commercially valuable proprietary asset to telecom operators.

product_updates.title: Tilly Norwood’s press tour is going about as well as you’d expect for an AI
product_updates.content: In one particularly odd interview, Norwood seems to malfunction and begin speaking Chinese.
